license.notes: Club species (Zoo 0.87.0). REFERENCE: the walker's two GTA IV Triangle Club frames and a local 1990s neighbourhood club used for layout only -- a round raised stage with a centre pole, a padded rail on brass posts round its edge and a plain warm rope light along the lip and the step nosings; a runway with the pole at its round end; and a stage that is the middle of an oval bar, stools round a padded bar rail. Pre-renovation: no LED panels. Geometry planned purely in core/club_forms.py. HEIGHTS: a slot up to 0.9 m is the platform alone; up to 1.16 m the platform is the slot less the 0.36 m rail; taller, the platform is 0.8 m (Deli Counter's own stage height) and the pole runs to the slot's top, so author the volume to the ceiling. STEPS: the fewest (1-3, 0.34 m treads) that keep a ramp over them at or under 44 degrees. BUDGET 5000: measured 4652 at the genome's largest bar_stage (14 x 8 x 5: 2996 for the stage and 1656 for the worst of eight seeds of bar stock on its two straight runs); a round stage is 4128 at that size.
